kitDescription: Rei Ayanami is a Fire-element Burst III Attacker on a machine gun (300-round belt, 40s burst cooldown). Her first skill runs off a 100-normal-attack counter: every 100 rounds she gives herself a short 3-second boost to damage she deals while holding elemental advantage, and simultaneously fires a single extra hit at the enemy nearest her crosshair for 112.37% of her final ATK. Her second skill is a permanent passive that massively increases the damage she does to enemy shields, plus — whenever the team reaches Burst stage 3 — a 10-second ATK grant to every Fire ally scaled off her own ATK. Her burst shields all Fire allies for 13.44% of her max HP and raises their attack damage by 48.02% for 10 seconds, then detonates a 990.2%-of-final-ATK hit on all enemies. In a solo-raid context against a partless, shieldless boss her shield-damage passive does nothing and the shield is purely defensive, so her practical contribution is the periodic 112% procs, the Fire-ally ATK/damage buffs (which land on herself), and the burst nuke.

redAssertions: S5 blind: 'removing rei's S1B 112.37% flatDamage rider leaves teammates' totals byte-identical' — FAILS vs the driver's shipped override because flatDamage riders call skillGauge() (engine fact f), so deleting the rider shifts rei's gauge fill → her burst timing → the team's Full-Burst cadence, moving crown/liter by ~0.02%. The rider is pure personal DAMAGE but is not gauge-neutral; the blind's inertness premise is over-strict. Classified RECON_ERROR, not an override defect. All other 9 blind assertions GREEN; 2 skipped as documented magnitude GAPs (burst-shield magnitude, S1a elemAdvantage magnitude).

skill1.blindSaid: S6 identical block byte-for-byte; S5 pinned the buffApply structure + advantage-inertness (vs a Fire boss) and skipped magnitude as measurement-gated
skill1.formulaCheck: elemAdvantageDamagePct is a real StatKey living in the ELEMENT bucket (damage-calculation.md §1c: Element = 1.1 + (Element Dmg ▲ + Superior-element ▲)/100, advantage-only). Engine self-gates via BEATS[Fire]=Wind, so it pays only vs a Wind boss and is inert otherwise — exactly the prose's 'Elemental Advantage Attack Damage'. 'for 3 sec' → durationSec (wall-clock), not durationShots; correct, the line says sec not round(s).
skill1.explanation: Trigger, scope, stat, bucket and duration semantics all match. Cadence is asserted, not assumed: the driver test pins applied.length == floor(reiShots/100) (MG hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ one hit per shot) and each window at exactly 180 frames, so the block demonstrably FIRES over the 180s fight rather than merely existing.

skill1.driverSaid: second independent hitCount 100 block → enemy → flatDamage atkPct 112.37 (no crit flag ⇒ engine default crit-ON, no core, noRange forced)
skill1.blindSaid: S6 identical plus explicit crit:true (semantic no-op: engine treats crit !== false as ON). S5 confirmed live, 100-hit-gated not per-shot, no core, no range; its only RED was the team-inertness assertion (RECON_ERROR above)
skill1.formulaCheck: 'Deals X% of final ATK as damage' = function-type skill damage (game-mechanics §9): crits at caster rate, NEVER core (text lacks 'core strike'), never range, takes the FB +50% by actual landing time. Driver leaves noFb unset ⇒ FB-by-timing — correct, since this is a skill-slot proc, not a burst-cast lump; the burst-cast pre-FB rule does not apply to it. Bucket asserted 'skill'.
skill1.explanation: Encoding matches prose and the rider rules. Cadence pinned to floor(shots/100) with an explicit riders.length < shots guard (rules out a per-shot misencoding) and at least one proc asserted with fbMajorApplied true (rules out a wrongly-set noFb). Modelling the 'landing 100' counter as a second independent hitCount:100 is exact on a hitscan MG where every shot lands; the S6 blind filed the fired-vs-landed desync risk as a ⚑, which is the right disposition.

skill2.kitLine: start of battle: Dmg dealt to Shield ▲700.5%
skill2.driverSaid: Not encoded anywhere; recorded verbatim in unmodeled.skill2 with the reason (no shield-damage StatKey; partless scope-lock boss has no shield pool)
skill2.blindSaid: S6 independently placed the same line in unmodeled.skill2 (fuller verbatim quote, same ruling) and called it 'the single biggest missing piece if a shielded boss is ever in scope'; S5 asserted no buff with value 700.5 exists in the run; S2b called any nonzero encoding an ~8× over-credit trap
skill2.formulaCheck: 'Damage dealt to Shield' scopes to enemy shield HP only; the schema has no shield-damage StatKey and the v1 boss has no shield pool, so the line is mechanically inert (verified engine fact h). Encoding it as attackDamagePct/damageTakenPct would be a catastrophic over-credit with no formula basis.
skill2.explanation: This is the kit's dominant number and the designed trap; all four independent reads (driver, S2b, S5, S6) agree it must be inert and unmodeled, and it is recorded in `unmodeled` rather than silently dropped. Correctly a DOCUMENTED_GAP, not a SILENT_DROP.

skill2.kitLine: entering Burst stage 3, Fire allies: ATK ▲25.03%
skill2.driverSaid: stageEnter { stage: 3 } → alliesOfElement Fire → buff casterAtkPct 25.03, durationSec 10
skill2.blindSaid: S6 EXACT MATCH on trigger, target, stat, value and duration — the single most load-bearing convergence in the packet; S6 additionally flagged in prose that keying this to burstCast would UNDER-credit in a 2×B3 comp. S5 confirmed it fires on the helm co-B3's casts too
skill2.formulaCheck: 'ATK ▲ X% of the skill user's ATK' = casterAtkPct — a FLAT add of the caster's static ATK resolved at apply, OUTSIDE the recipient's (1+ΣATK%) sum (damage-calculation.md §1a), not plain atkPct which would dilute against other ATK buffs. 'Entering Burst stage 3' = stageEnter{stage:3} (fires on ANY B3 cast), distinct from burstCast (own-cast only) and fullBurstEnter (verified engine fact d). Target scope alliesOfElement Fire includes self (no 'except self' clause).
skill2.explanation: Every axis of this line is separately pinned: the stat by buffApply key `2:skill2:casterAtkPct:25.03` against an atkPct counterfactual, the target by holder set {REI} against a generic-allies counterfactual reaching {0,1,2}, the duration at 600 frames, and — critically — the trigger identity by the helm co-B3 fixture where applies == reiCasts + helmCasts > reiCasts. That last assertion is the strongest discriminator in the suite; it is the exact axis S2b and S6 both independently flagged.

burst.kitLine: Shield 13.44% of caster final Max HP, 10s
burst.driverSaid: Encoded as shield { maxHpPct 13.44, durationSec 10 } on the burstCast/Fire-allies block, with ⚑3 in note + caveats stating it is event-only (no HP pool in v1; fires shielded triggers only) and is therefore asserted nowhere in the test
burst.blindSaid: S6 encoded the identical shield effect and kept it explicitly for tandem reasons ('offensively inert alone but emits a shield event that fires teammates' shielded triggers and satisfies requiresShielded gates'); S5 skipped magnitude as an unassertable GAP (no HP pool, no shield-synergy consumer)
burst.formulaCheck: Verified engine fact (g): shield models no HP pool and emits no damage/buff log event — it only sets shieldedUntilFrame and fires recipients' `shielded` triggers / opens requiresShielded gates (game-mechanics §9, the naga machinery). With no shield-synergy consumer in the fixture it is unobservable end-to-end, so nothing beyond its presence is assertable.
burst.explanation: Encoded (not dropped as a 'defensive, no damage' line — the trap S2b named), correctly scoped to Fire allies and to rei's own burstCast, and its unobservability is documented as ⚑3 rather than papered over. Being present-but-unasserted is the honest disposition here: DOCUMENTED_GAP, not a fire-rate failure, since the block genuinely has no observable in this comp. If a shield-consumer teammate is ever added, this line becomes assertable and should be pinned then.

burst.kitLine: Attack damage ▲ 48.02% for 10 sec, Fire allies
burst.driverSaid: burstCast → alliesOfElement Fire → buff attackDamagePct 48.02, durationSec 10 (co-listed with the shield on one block)
burst.blindSaid: S6 identical (same block, same stat/value/duration/target); S5 confirmed live + Fire-only
burst.formulaCheck: 'Attack damage ▲' = the additive DamageUp bucket (damage-calculation.md §1e), NOT atkPct (which sits inside FinalATK and dilutes against liter/crown ATK support) and NOT an element- or crit-scoped term. Plain-% stats log their raw value, so buffApply value 48.02 is the correct signature. burstCast-keyed ⇒ applied at cast, i.e. before the FB countdown, so the 10s window covers the whole Full Burst.
burst.explanation: Bucket, magnitude, target scope, trigger and duration all match prose and formula. Cadence pinned at applies == rei's burstCast count with a 600-frame window; LIVE-ness proven by a removal reference that moves her total; target scope proven against the generic-allies counterfactual; and the helm fixture proves it does NOT fire on helm's B3 casts — the mirror image of the S2b stageEnter assertion, which together form the trigger-identity triangle.

burst.kitLine: all enemies: Deals 990.2% of final ATK
burst.driverSaid: Second burst block, burstCast → enemy → flatDamage atkPct 990.2; noFb NOT authored (relies on the engine's burst-cast FB exemption)
burst.blindSaid: S6 identical plus explicit crit:true (no-op) and a ⚑ noting noFb was deliberately left unset pending a popup read. S2b asserted the line 'needs noFb:true' — see explanation; that is a spec-level over-specification, not a driver defect. S5 confirmed FB-exempt + no-range
burst.formulaCheck: Verified engine fact (e): a burstCast-keyed flatDamage is FB-EXEMPT structurally — the cast resolves before the FB window opens, so it takes neither the +0.5 major nor entry auras (damage-calculation.md §1b Full Burst timing rule, the popup-verified Cinderella boundary measurement). An explicit noFb flag is therefore redundant, not required. Never core ('as damage', not 'as core strike damage'), noRange forced, crits at sheet rate. 'All enemies' collapses to the single partless boss.
burst.explanation: S2b's demand for an explicit noFb:true is the one place the pre-op spec over-specifies against the engine: the exemption is structural to burstCast ordering, and the driver's test verifies the OBSERVABLE (nukes.filter(fbMajorApplied) === []) rather than the flag, which is the stronger check — it would catch the over-credit regardless of how the exemption is implemented. Magnitude, bucket ('burst'), crit/core eligibility, and once-per-own-cast cadence are all separately pinned, including the helm fixture showing nukes == reiCasts < reiCasts + helmCasts.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA of any subkind survives review: all 7 kit lines are either FAITHFUL (5) or a recorded DOCUMENTED_GAP (2 — the 700.5% shield-damage passive in `unmodeled.skill2`, and the burst shield's unobservable magnitude as ⚑3), giving faithfulness 7/7 = 1.0. Convergence is strong and mechanical: the S6 blind override is byte-equivalent to the driver's on every load-bearing axis — the only deltas are two explicit crit:true additions on the flatDamage riders (a semantic NO-OP, since the engine's default is crit !== false ⇒ ON) and a wording difference in the unmodeled.skill2 quote; both agents independently landed on stageEnter{stage:3} + alliesOfElement Fire + casterAtkPct 25.03/10s, which is the kit's hardest and most-flagged line. The pristine S5 blind suite ran 9 GREEN / 1 RED / 2 documented skips against the driver's shipped override, and I rule the single RED a RECON_ERROR, not a defect: the blind asserted that removing rei's S1B 112.37% rider leaves teammates byte-identical, but flatDamage riders call skillGauge() (engine fact f), so the rider feeds burst gauge and its removal shifts the team's Full-Burst cadence by ~0.02% — the rider is pure personal damage but is not gauge-neutral, so the blind's inertness premise was too strict, and prose + formula both side with the driver. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing line, and notably not by construction: S1a is proven three ways (LIVE vs a Wind boss, byte-identical GATED vs an Iron boss, and an ungated attackDamagePct counterfactual that provably DOES move the Iron-boss total — the exact over-credit S2b named); S1b/RA5 discriminate against core:true; S2b/RA4 against both generic-allies and atkPct; and the helm co-B3 fixture resolves the stageEnter-vs-burstCast triangle in both directions. Fire-rate is verified rather than assumed for every FAITHFUL block — proc counts pinned to floor(shots/100), buff applies to burst-cast counts, and window lengths to 180/600 frames. Two items for the owner to spot-check, neither blocking: (i) the same-model residual is that S2b's insistence on an explicit noFb:true for the 990.2% nuke was correctly overridden by the driver on the basis of the engine's structural burst-cast FB exemption — the test verifies the observable (fbMajorApplied empty) instead of the flag, which is stronger, but an owner who ever changes burst-cast ordering should re-read that assertion; and (ii) the burst shield is present-but-unassertable in this comp (no HP pool, no shield-synergy consumer), so its correctness rests on structural inspection alone until a shield-consuming teammate exists. All magnitudes are literal blablalink kit text (DATAMINED, out of scope per F); the only always-⚑ quantity in play is the MG cadence tuple (reloadFrames 171 is unverified datamine), which lives in base stats rather than in any kit line and is flagged as ⚑2.
